title: ai-atoms hook v1
description: A hook atom — an event-driven runtime behavior wired into AI tool infrastructure (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, etc.).

id.description: Namespaced identifier in the form hook/<slug>.

version.description: Semantic version of this hook atom.

description.description: What this hook does, what event it responds to, and what it enforces or emits.

event.description: The AI tool event this hook responds to (e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, SessionEnd, SubagentStop, PreCompact).

language.description: Implementation language of the hook script.

trigger.description: Condition under which this hook fires.

type.description: How the hook matches: by tool name, file path pattern, always, or tool category.

pattern.description: Glob or regex pattern used with tool-name and file-pattern trigger types.

script_path.description: Relative path to the hook implementation script within this repository.

blocking.description: If true, the hook can abort the triggering operation. If false, it is advisory only.

side_effects.description: Observable effects of this hook (e.g. writes to audit log, emits warning to stderr).

authored_by.description: Key atom ID or author identifier.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage of this hook atom.
